cited.basis: Articles 5, 6 and 10 each say that the canon will thenceforth have a third paragraph, and print it. The new c. 1108 §3 is the one that matters most: it reserves valid assistance at a marriage involving an Eastern party to a priest. [Latin delivery, lines 64, 66, 74.]
